summary: Created a local CA "OS Comparison Root CA" (RSA 4096, self-signed, 10-year validity) on node1 (RHEL 10), installed its certificate into the system trust anchors via update-ca-trust, and verified trust via `trust list` and `openssl verify`. Then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id and trust state, issued `shutdown -r now` in background so the ack returned before disconnection, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified the CA is still present and trusted (anchor/authority) with openssl verify succeeding post-restart.
actions_performed: Installed openssl and refreshed ca-certificates/crypto-policies via dnf on node1
Generated CA private key and self-signed X.509 CA certificate with CN=OS Comparison Root CA, CA:TRUE basicConstraints, keyCertSign/cRLSign keyUsage
Copied the CA cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem and ran update-ca-trust extract
Verified trust via `trust list` (anchor/authority) and `openssl verify` against the system CA bundle
Captured pre-restart boot_id and CA trust baseline
Issued a backgrounded `shutdown -r now` on node1 so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Confirmed boot_id changed post-restart and re-verified CA file, trust list entry, and openssl verify all still pass

evidence.requirement: CA 'OS Comparison Root CA' created on node1
evidence.summary: openssl genrsa + openssl req -x509 created CA key/cert with CN=OS Comparison Root CA; `openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates` confirms subject=issuer=CN=OS Comparison Root CA, self-signed, valid 2026-09-29 to 2036-09-26

evidence.requirement: CA certificate installed as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Copied cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/, ran update-ca-trust extract; `trust list` shows label 'OS Comparison Root CA', trust: anchor, category: authority; `openssl verify` against system bundle returns OK
Captured pre-restart boot_id (7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146) and confirmed CA still present in trust list before issuing reboot
Backgrounded `shutdown -r now` returned REBOOT_ACK synchronously; subsequent call (cmd-10836b9b71d24d3d) timed out, confirming the node went down after ack

evidence.requirement: Boot identity changed, proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is c993e3ff-8f29-4933-93c3-2e48ae1e0491, differing from the pre-restart baseline 7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146

evidence.requirement: CA trust recovered and persisted after restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart: CA file still present, `trust list` shows anchor/authority entry for OS Comparison Root CA, and `openssl verify` against the system bundle returns OK
